body_text:
Twin prime conjecture. There exist infinitely many primes $p$
for which $p+2$ is also prime. Such pairs are called twin
primes. Results proving infinitely many prime pairs within a
fixed bounded distance do not by themselves prove that the
distance $2$ occurs infinitely often.
